routes.name: deterministic
routes.scope: typed data/formula owners; no invented observation

routes.name: verifiedKnowledge
routes.scope: existing bounded mechanism packet or reviewed argument support; missing requirements retained

routes.name: controlledSynthesis
routes.scope: existing gateway, server entitlement/admission, adequate minimal evidence pack, reserved budget and independent authorization

budgetInputsRequired: effective provider/model rate card and date
measured tokenizer counts per source and language
incremental changed-unit count keyed by textVersion
query count/cache hit rate and permission-version cache keys
retrieved candidates per rerank and billed pairs
bounded repair count and maximum total spend
cross-language query/answer route and translation review

formulae.incrementalEmbedding: sum(tokens of changed admitted textVersion units) * rate / 1e6; revoke invalidated cache entries
formulae.repairCeiling: initial cost + maximumRepairAttempts * boundedRepairCost; reserve before execution
formulae.crossLanguage: separate token counts per language, plus explicitly selected translation cost; no implicit translation call

semanticVectorEvaluation: MISSING_EFFECTIVENESS_MEASUREMENT: no approved local embedding artifact or provider authorization supplied; lexical/concept expansion is not a semantic vector result
